verses.en: That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life;
verses.pt: O que era desde o princípio, o que ouvimos, o que vimos com os nossos olhos, o que contemplamos e as nossas mãos apalparam, a respeito do Verbo da vida
verses.en_web: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life
verses.en_bbe: That which was from the first, which has come to our ears, and which we have seen with our eyes, looking on it and touching it with our hands, about the Word of life

verses.en: (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and shew unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;)
verses.pt: (pois a vida foi manifestada, e nós a temos visto, e dela testificamos, e vos anunciamos a vida eterna, que estava com o Pai, e a nós foi manifestada);
verses.en_web: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);
verses.en_bbe: (And the life was made clear to us, and we have seen it and are witnessing to it and giving you word of that eternal life which was with the Father and was seen by us);

verses.en: That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that ye also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ.
verses.pt: sim, o que vimos e ouvimos, isso vos anunciamos, para que vós também tenhais comunhão conosco; e a nossa comunhão é com o Pai, e com seu Filho Jesus Cristo.
verses.en_web: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.
verses.en_bbe: We give you word of all we have seen and everything which has come to our ears, so that you may be united with us; and we are united with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ:

verses.en: And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full.
verses.pt: Estas coisas vos escrevemos, para que o nosso gozo seja completo.
verses.en_web: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.
verses.en_bbe: And we are writing these things to you so that our joy may be made complete.

verses.en: This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.pt: E esta é a mensagem que dele ouvimos, e vos anunciamos: que Deus é luz, e nele não há trevas nenhumas.
verses.en_web: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.
verses.en_bbe: This is the word which came to us from him and which we give to you, that God is light and in him there is nothing dark.

verses.en: If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth:
verses.pt: Se dissermos que temos comunhão com ele, e andarmos nas trevas, mentimos, e não praticamos a verdade;
verses.en_web: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don’t tell the truth.
verses.en_bbe: If we say we are joined to him, and are walking still in the dark, our words are false and our acts are untrue:

verses.en: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.
verses.pt: mas, se andarmos na luz, como ele na luz está, temos comunhão uns com os outros, e o sangue de Jesus seu Filho nos purifica de todo pecado.
verses.en_web: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.
verses.en_bbe: But if we are walking in the light, as he is in the light, we are all united with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.

verses.en: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.pt: Se dissermos que não temos pecado nenhum, enganamo-nos a nós mesmos, e a verdade não está em nós.
verses.en_web: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
verses.en_bbe: If we say that we have no sin, we are false to ourselves and there is nothing true in us.

verses.en: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.pt: Se confessarmos os nossos pecados, ele é fiel e justo para nos perdoar os pecados e nos purificar de toda injustiça.
verses.en_web: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
verses.en_bbe: If we say openly that we have done wrong, he is upright and true to his word, giving us forgiveness of sins and making us clean from all evil.

verses.en: If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.pt: Se dissermos que não temos cometido pecado, fazemo-lo mentiroso, e a sua palavra não está em nós.
verses.en_web: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.
verses.en_bbe: If we say that we have no sin, we make him false and his word is not in us.
